preconditions.description: The size of the first part of the graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The size of the second part of the graph must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of edges in the graph must be between 0 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= a and 1 <= y <= b for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect a valid vertex in the first part to a valid vertex in the second part.

postconditions.description: The minimal number of colours used must be at least 1 and at most the number of edges.

postconditions.expression: len(colours) == m and all(1 <= colour <= c for colour in colours)
postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m colours, each between 1 and c.

postconditions.expression: all(colours[i] != colours[j] for i in range(m) for j in range(i + 1, m) if (edges[i][0] == edges[j][0] or edges[i][1] == edges[j][1]))
postconditions.description: No two adjacent edges must have the same colour.
